gives: Walks every stop, or until it is paused, then gives back the report. Call it again to go on. ignore is a list of CSS selectors to leave out, like a part broken on purpose. delay is the wait at each stop, 400 ms if you leave it out. An ignore entry that isn't valid CSS makes it fail with an error. quiet: true puts the scroll and focus back where they were when it ends, so every mark it found shows on the page you started from.
Every open problem as data, never cut short: id (the same on every run), check, wcag, selector, html, component, fix, verify.
Every Log line as data: time, result, check, wcag, text, fixed, selector, stop.

{ walked, total, done, untested }. done is true once Play reached the end. untested names the checks that never ran, like Lost focus when no popup was opened, so a green test can tell a clean page from a check that was skipped.
With a CSS selector, the Tab presses from the top of the page to that element, or null if Tab never reaches it. Without one, the goals Tab cost finds: name, presses, how it was found, selector.
How many stops sit in each region: { header, nav, main, aside, footer, other }.
